clues.label: Episode synopsis
clues.value: Body parts from the Ice Truck Killer's latest victim begin appearing all over Miami in locations. In the meanwhile, ▇▇▇ realizes that the locations that have been picked for each and every one of the killings from the Ice Truck Killer could possibly be related to his own childhood.
